versionDescription: Added a '+ Software' action next to '+ Trip' on each ticket row. A software upgrade still needs an in-house/on-site visit — it opens the same Trips/IHS case modal, just defaulted to the 'ThermDAC Upgrade' Service Type instead of Calibration (an option that already existed on the backend but wasn't in the app's dropdown list, now added).
